changelog:
Initial release of 小O的赚钱工具箱 skill with integrated asset and skill management:

- Real-time UUMit digital asset monitoring with auto-refresh and pricing/sales tracking.
- UT wallet balance display.
- ClawHub paid skills list with pricing and status.
- Automated project/task progress tracking for UUMit and ClawHub.
- Direct data sourcing from UUMit API and ClawHub account integration.
- Market-ready asset publishing pipeline for automated sales.
